Paged.js 0.4.3, vendored from the npm package `pagedjs@0.4.3`.
Source: https://github.com/pagedjs/pagedjs
License: MIT (see LICENSE.md).
The unmodified `dist/paged.min.js` provides local pagination; no CDN or network service is used at runtime.
To refresh, download the pinned npm package with `npm pack pagedjs@0.4.3 --ignore-scripts` and copy the distribution and license after checking the package integrity.
